scientific_integrity: Proof supplied for all stated graphs and couplings; standalone finite-dimensional numerical experiments corroborate without certifying infinite families. The generic nonresonant mean-mixing shift and general projector formula are credited to prior literature; originality is asserted only for the collision classification, projector jump, cross-component continuity at resonance, and critical-window law, subject to independent priority review.
scientific_limitations: Only finite connected simple regular undirected components, all-to-all uniform strictly positive intercomponent hopping, adjacency Hamiltonian, coherent single-particle evolution, and Cesaro time averaging. The collision jump is a long-time limit, not a fixed-time discontinuity; no claim of disorder or decoherence robustness. The graph-fixed finite-window law and separately stated uniform equal-clique formula have different scopes.
title: Spectral-collision spikes and finite-time sinc windows in weighted quantum joins
